cues.en: Thus far, we covered a lot of important basics you'll need for building Ionic Angular applications.

cues.zh: 我們如何在 Ionic app 中設定並使用主題，而主題就是色彩、字型之類的東西、

cues.en: how we can use CSS variables to our advantage and what CSS variables actually are and how
